note: REST doors against their agent twins, door by door (scripts/inventory/field-reach.ts). `rest-only:<field> <route>`: the route reads the record field and no twin tool declares it. `no-twin:<route>`: the route reads record fields and no agent tool does the same job. `no-twin-write:<route>`: a POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE route that reads no record field, and no agent tool does the same job. `unnamed:` and `unrouted:` hold, per file, the reads the measurement cannot place. Seeded so the gate fails only on a NEW entry. "NOT YET REVIEWED" is a question nobody has answered, not a clearance; an answered entry says why only a person with a browser is meant to reach it.

An agent that wants the rule's answer on a state runs the rule (aimeat_decide { rule, state }), which is the same call, recorded as a decision of the rule. The door stands behind requireOwnerPrincipal().
exempt.no-twin:POST /v1/classification/policy/r: ANSWERED 2026-09-29: only a person may reach this one (TARGET-082, decided 2026-09-29). It accepts or rejects an AI's waiting proposal to loosen a classification policy, and a loosening gives something away, so it waits for a person signed in themselves. reviewPolicy (services/classification/policy-admin.ts) refuses every credential that is not a person's own session with PERSON_REQUIRED, the person's words relayed by an AI included; an agent tool for it would be refused on every call. The agent's road is aimeat_classification, action policy_set, which keeps a loosening as the proposal this door reviews and tells the AI to ask the person to accept or reject it signed in themselves (POLICY_PENDING_NEXT). Asserted in test/unit/classification-levels.test.ts ('applies an AI's tightening at once and keeps its loosening for the person').
exempt.rest-only:language GET /v1/catalogue/kno: Listed 2026-09-28 only because AiJobRecord (services/ai-jobs/types.ts) gained `language` for a transcription job, which added the word to the record field names. The door's `language` is one of its six catalogue filters (page, limit, content_type, tags, language, sort), and aimeat_knowledge_list declares none of them on the connector and the dispatch, which predates this; giving the tool its filters is its own piece of work, not this field's.
exempt.rest-only:bands POST /v1/ai/decide: ANSWERED 2026-09-20: the door reads `bands` only to REFUSE it. A call that names a rule sends only the state; `bands` (like `questions` and `thresholds`) beside a rule answers 400 RULE_FIXES_QUESTIONS, and without a rule the field is not read at all. There is nothing for a twin to forward: a tool that declared `bands` would declare a parameter whose only effect is a refusal. On the MCP doors an undeclared `bands` is stripped by the schema before the call, and the rule's own bands apply, which is the same outcome the refusal protects.
